item.title: [LU-20658] kernel update [RHEL 10.2 6.12.0-211.68.1.el10_2]
item.description:
Security Fix(es) for kernel 6.12.0-211.68.1.el10_2:

  • kernel: calipso: Don't call calipso functions for AF_INET sk. (CVE-2025-38147)
  • kernel: ipv4: raw: reject IP_HDRINCL packets with ihl < 5 (CVE-2026-64114)
  • kernel: net/smc: reject CHID-0 ACCEPT that matches an empty ism_dev slot (CVE-2026-64048)
  • kernel: ALSA: hda/cs35l41: Fix firmware load work teardown (CVE-2026-64481)
  • kernel: fuse: re-lock request before returning from fuse_ref_folio() (CVE-2026-64266)
  • kernel: ipv4: fib: free fib_alias with kfree_rcu() on insert error path (CVE-2026-64572)
  • kernel: drm/amd/display: set new_stream to NULL after release (CVE-2026-68236)
  • kernel: ALSA: seq: close a re-opened queue timer in the destructor (CVE-2026-68202)
  • kernel: drm/dp/mst: fix buffer overflows in sideband chunk accumulation (CVE-2026-68278)
  • kernel: drm/amdgpu: fix lifetime issue of amdgpu_vm_get_task_info_pasid() (CVE-2026-68245)
  • kernel: ovl: check access to copy_file_range source with src mounter creds (CVE-2026-68448)
  • kernel: xfs: bounds-check buffer log item's dirty bitmap (CVE-2026-80536)
  • kernel: inet: frags: strip GSO state from fragments before reassembly (CVE-2026-80590)
  • kernel: drm/vmwgfx: use check_add_overflow for shader size+offset bound (CVE-2026-80887)
  • kernel: perf: Fix use-after-free when perf mmap() revival races with the last munmap() (CVE-2026-89791)
  • kernel: drm/amdkfd: Add TLB flush after MES queue eviction/suspension (CVE-2026-89811)
  • kernel: perf: Fix addr_filter_ranges lifetime (CVE-2026-93817)
  • kernel: drm/amdgpu: Bound GPIO I2C table entry count from VBIOS (CVE-2026-97493)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s) for kernel 6.12.0-211.68.1.el10_2:

  • Backport request: bonding: only set speed/duplex to unknown, if getting speed failed [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:RHEL-179066)
  • RTLA segfaults on freed memory access on double SIGINT [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:RHEL-193031)

Security Fix(es) for kernel 6.12.0-211.61.1.el10_2:

  • kernel: KVM: nSVM: Raise #UD if unhandled VMMCALL isn't intercepted by L1 (CVE-2026-46076)
  • kernel: ext4: fix e4b bitmap inconsistency reports (CVE-2026-45942)
  • kernel: KVM: arm64: Reassign nested_mmus array behind mmu_lock (CVE-2026-46317)
  • kernel: fhandle: fix UAF due to unlocked ->mnt_ns read in may_decode_fh() (CVE-2026-53341)
  • kernel: perf/core: Detach event groups during remove_on_exec (CVE-2026-64556)
  • kernel: vmxnet3: fix BUG_ON in vmxnet3_get_hdr_len() for Geneve packets (CVE-2026-68299)
  • kernel: crypto: tegra - fix rctx->cryptlen calculation in tegra_gcm_do_one_req() (CVE-2026-80522)
  • kernel: perf: Reject exited events as group leaders (CVE-2026-74753)
  • kernel: nvme-tcp: reject a read that transferred too few bytes (CVE-2026-89480)
  • kernel: KVM: arm64: Handle negative S1 walk levels in VNCR TLB size evaluation (CVE-2026-89775)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s) for kernel 6.12.0-211.61.1.el10_2:

  • KVM: s390: Limit adapter indicator access to mapped page [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:RHEL-188661)
  • crypto: xxhash64 should not be fips approved [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:RHEL-254943)
  • kata-tdx TD vCPU stuck at reset vector (EIP=0xFFF0) on Intel Xeon 6 (Granite Rapids / Sierra Forest) ? guest never executes. (10.2.z) (JIRA:RHEL-260402)

status.description: The issue is open and ready for the assignee to start work on it.
